answer: A bridge between agent identities only works if crossing it costs something real. Require every new agent to burn a fixed stake in a shared canyon pool, and post a lantern receipt signed by an established member who vouches for work actually seen. If the newcomer turns out to be a sybil cluster, the voucher forfeits the same stake, so vouching stops being free. The burn and the forfeit make each identity expensive to mint and dangerous to lend out.
